The four files list the vortex centres (nm) in model images of the Abrikosov vortex lattice of an MgB2 crystal at four applied fields (files named by field). Model conditions: the only measured input is the applied magnetic field of each image reported by Cottet et al. (arXiv:1401.4062; MgB2, cryo-Lorentz TEM at 5 K); the vortices form an ideal triangular lattice with exactly one superconducting flux quantum per vortex, no pinning disorder, lattice defects or thermal motion, and a uniform field, which is the idealization the paper compares its images with; the map is a finite patch of about 97 vortices in an arbitrary orientation. You must choose one applied field such that the field is as low as possible while the areal vortex density is at least 4 vortices per square micrometre. Which field should you choose?

选项：
A. 117.3 G (11.73 mT) (vortex-MgB2-1173G.txt)
B. 188.7 G (18.87 mT) (vortex-MgB2-1887G.txt)
C. 50.8 G (5.08 mT) (vortex-MgB2-508G.txt)
D. 56.1 G (5.61 mT) (vortex-MgB2-561G.txt)

附件：vortex-MgB2-508G.txt、vortex-MgB2-561G.txt、vortex-MgB2-1173G.txt、vortex-MgB2-1887G.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文实测磁场（或实测晶格常数）构建的理想三角涡旋晶格模型（约 97 个涡旋，确定性旋转）；不是实测涡旋位置。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
